## Evidencia tangible

El evidence pack oficial ya no es una lista de todas las olas. Es el conjunto
minimo que permite defender que Paper 4 existe como laboratorio reproducible.

| finding_id | finding | status | quarto_page |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F01 | Paper 4 is now a reproducible sequential-decision living lab, not a final promotion protocol. | official | index.qmd |
| F02 | CRPTO/Paper_CRPTO remains the official project champion after the v31-v38 audit. | official | 19ca-v38-final-synthesis.qmd |
| F03 | Dynamic stress replay reached 512 common paths and 494592 trace rows. | official | 19t-multi-period-solver.qmd |
| F04 | The strongest CVaR challenger reduced tail loss but did not beat paired wealth robustly; prob beat reference = 0.4765625. | official | 19i-regret-auditability-frontier.qmd |
| F05 | Online conformal passed the nominal v10 gate but v35 strict holdouts did not survive universally; online_gate_survives_v35 = False. | official_with_caveat | 19n-online-mdcp-fairness.qmd |
| F06 | SPO/DFL has an oracle-regret/surrogate lane, while differentiable SPO remains isolated-prototype only. | isolated_prototype | 19t-multi-period-solver.qmd |
| F07 | DLA/ADP has a formal state/transition framing and failure analysis, but not exact Bellman optimality. | rollout_only | 19t-multi-period-solver.qmd |
| F08 | IFRS9 is supported as an ECL/SICR-inspired proxy lane with one raw-enriched diagnostic available. | bounded_experiment | 19b-current-assets-and-gaps.qmd |
| F09 | CATE policy value remains blocked, but a high-rate-within-grade diagnostic can be audited. | diagnostic_only | 19b-current-assets-and-gaps.qmd |
| F10 | Fairness remains proxy/source governance only because protected attributes or approved proxy protocol are absent. | proxy_only | 19n-online-mdcp-fairness.qmd |
| F11 | Powell/SDAM is useful as a governance and framing contract, not as an automatic optimizer. | official | 19f-sequential-decision-framework.qmd |
| F12 | Literature-driven Lab 4 pass closes lanes 1-9 as append, park or context-only evidence. | official_with_boundaries | 19ca-v38-final-synthesis.qmd |
| F13 | Paper 4 absorbs the useful prudential value of Paper 2: ECL scenarios, conformal SICR, CIF/prepayment, stage-cost governance and TS->ECL context. | official_with_boundary | 19ca-v38-final-synthesis.qmd |
| F14 | Metric governance shows the calibrated champion materially improves over an origin-time FICO proxy on latest OOT scoring diagnostics. | append | 19cb-v38-appendix-registers.qmd |

## Regla de uso

Cuando una nueva ola produzca resultados, primero se agrega al notebook. Solo si
se vuelve estable, artifact-backed y claim-safe se promueve a una pagina oficial.
